spans.text: When the Cosmic Teardrops appeared in the universe they carved their way through time, space, and planar boundaries. Though they crashed in Somnus Domina, they left a trail of eidomantic energy and chunks behind them in the universe as they traveled. On Somnus Domina, the first teardrop left a set of undying conceptual beings called the Grand Primaries in its wake, who immediately began exterminating all life on Somnus Domina and brought about the Age of Sunderance. However, that same Teardrop also impacted a planet whose name was lost to history, destroying most of it as it passed through and leaving behind another Grand Primary known now as Luminal Minus. Luminal Minus exterminated and consumed all remaining life on that planet, but was consequently sealed with the planet’s remains in a Far Realm outside the Material Plane. Thirsting for eidomantic radiation it was now deprived of, it reached out from its Far Realm into the Material Plane, creating an alien species to hunt and consume eidomantic life on its behalf: the Outer Titans.

The Cosmic Teardrops left thesite and eidomantic radiation in their wake, and these are precisely what outer titans are drawn to. They seek to consume ambient eidomantic energy, both from the atmosphere and from what remains in living creatures and objects. They consume everything voraciously, including having an unquenchable appetite for all life connected to Somnus Domina.

The first of Somnus Domina to become aware of the Outer Titans were the astral elves, who left for space before the Age of Sunderance began when they first became aware of an anomaly in reality far off in the depths of space. In their search for it they found the path left behind by the Cosmic Teardrop, and the Outer Titans that followed it. The astral elves found themselves at odds with them, and have waged a war to push back the Outer Titans since the Age of Sunderance.

Should the Outer Titans ever discover that Somnus Domina is the primary receptacle of the Cosmic Teardrops, the planet would become the site of a simultaneously interstellar and interplanar conflict that would return it to conditions similar to the Age of Sunderance. Knowing this, the astral elves continue to draw the Outer Titans’ attention to the depths of the cosmos, and are exceedingly careful about returning to or contacting the planet.
Outer Titans do not require air, water, food, or nourishment of any sort to survive. They do not age, though they may become dormant or evolve over time.
